title: Welcome to My Blog
summary: Welcome to my personal blog & site! A place to share my knowledge and experiences as a software engineer.
html:
Welcome to My Blog!

I'm Adriano Caetano (adrianuf22), a software engineer passionate about building high-performance web applications, modern architectures, and delightful user experiences.

I created this space to centralize my daily findings, quick snippets, and straightforward solutions, like how to set up specific software and services, without the fluff.

What You'll Find Here

  • Straight-to-the-point technical snippets and configurations
  • Backend development tips
  • Software architecture notes
  • Homelab setup guides
  • AI tools and tuning

Stay tuned for more articles! Feel free to connect with me on GitHub or LinkedIn.
